title: Authentication & User Management
description: Secure user authentication system with an admin approval dashboard.
fulldescription: This prototype launches a complete authentication system using Amazon Cognito. It includes a pre-built Hosted UI for user sign-ups and sign-ins, so you don't have to build login forms from scratch. Crucially, it implements an 'Admin Approval' workflow: new users are placed in a pending state stored in Amazon DynamoDB until an administrator approves them via the included Admin Dashboard. AWS Lambda functions handle the secure logic for session management and protecting private API routes. It serves as a production-ready foundation for securing your applications.

services.name: Amazon Cognito
services.desc: Manages user identities, sign-ups, and secure sign-ins.

services.name: Amazon DynamoDB
services.desc: Stores pending user requests and active session data.

services.name: Lambda
services.desc: Runs the logic for approvals and verifying user sessions.

services.name: API Gateway
services.desc: Provides the secure web endpoints for the frontend application.

services.name: AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM)
services.desc: Securely manages permissions between the authentication services.
